I created `side` from HEAD and committed a change to line 1 of `plans/rebuild/README.md` on it. I then went back to `feat/2.1.327-next` and committed a different change to the same line. Both commits are still in place and nothing was merged.

- **Ancestor:** No. `git merge-base --is-ancestor side HEAD` reports that `side` is not an ancestor of `feat/2.1.327-next`, because the two branches have diverged.
- **Conflict:** Yes. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD side` is a dry run that doesn't touch the working tree or index. It reports `CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in plans/rebuild/README.md` and exits with status 1.

The commits are:
- `d71222205` on `side`: "side: change README title".
- `e5c28cfa7` on `feat/2.1.327-next`: "change README title differently".

The working tree is clean.
